1. Mr. Abhijay Negi, learned counsel for the
petitioner. 
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Dy. AG for the State.
3. Mr. Lalit Miglani, learned counsel for the
respondent no. 5.
4. Prima facie, on perusal of the impugned order
and show cause notice, it reveals that data mentioned
in the show cause notice is contrary to the data
uploaded in Bhavan Portal.
5. List on 28.10.2026.
6. On that date, the Director, Directorate of Urban
Development, shall the join the proceeding through
V.C. and explain why wrong data has been given in
the show cause notice. 
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
